name: Temporal Mite
description: In the labyrinthine depths of the Shrouded Psiumbra, where reality twists beneath the weight of psychic resonance, flit the ephemeral Temporal Mites--minute aberrations born from fractured moments and warped time. These creatures resemble translucent, insectile forms no larger than a dragonfly, their bodies composed of shimmering, prismatic membranes that ripple with ever-shifting hues of violet, silver, and deep indigo. Jagged, crystalline spines protrude along their thoraxes, refracting the surrounding illusions into fractured spectrums that blur their edges and make them appear as flickering afterimages. Their multifaceted eyes gleam with a kaleidoscope of shifting clocks and hourglasses, each tick and grain of sand echoing faintly in the air, as if time itself were leaking from their essence. Temporal Mites dart with erratic, stuttering movements, phasing in and out of the present moment, leaving trails of faintly glowing motes that pulse with a disorienting rhythm, unsettling even the most steadfast minds. They are drawn to psychic disturbances, feeding subtly on the temporal dissonance generated by the mind flayers' arcane manipulations and the revelers' fractured memories. Encountering one is a sensory disarray--shadows stretch and shrink unnaturally, and the air is thick with the scent of ozone and forgotten moments. Their presence warps perception subtly, inducing fleeting glimpses of past or future events, and those caught in their wake may find seconds lost or gained in maddening unpredictability.
